# Meross LAN 5.8.0 garage fixture

Unmodified upstream `garagedoor.py`, manifest and license from
[v5.8.0](https://github.com/krahabb/meross_lan/tree/v5.8.0).
The source SHA-256 is checked by `scripts/apply-meross-lan-msg200.py`.
Synthetic tests execute the patched command method with an invented two-channel
response and an injected transport; they never connect to equipment.
